title: Richard Feynman "Tiny Machines" Nanotechnology Lecture - aka "There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom"
summary: A recording of Richard Feynman's talk on the possibilities of manipulating matter at very small scales, widely seen as an early vision of nanotechnology. This is a later version of his 1959 "There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom" lecture.
why: HN points to it when discussing nanobots and microscale physics, including how things behave at tiny scales.

quote.text: there's a good richard feynam video about how things feel when they're that small
